pages.title: Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress | Marine. Doctor. Outsider.
pages.text:
Dr. Rich McCormick has spent his life running toward the fights that matter. As a Marine pilot, he landed aircraft in bad places and in bad weather. As ER doc, he’s led teams in Afghanistan and locally to save lives under critical conditions. He’s a leader that steps up when there’s a need. The Biden administration has cultivated inflation, regulation, taxation, and shame toward our nation. Dr. McCormick is exactly the kind of fighter needed during these critical times.
## 2nd Amendment Defended
September 27, 2022

pages.title: Priorities | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Priorities
Joe Biden has unleashed an unrelenting assault on our core values. 2022 might be our last chance to revive freedom and save America. A decorated Marine, Rich McCormick is prepared to lead this battle.

pages.title: Parents and Students Prioritized | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Parents and Students Prioritized
The radical left has gone too far when it comes to our children. They crippled kids’ social development with mask mandates and brainwashed them with radical ideologies. We need to get back to teaching kids, not punishing them.
And Rich is crystal clear on his own children: he is not interested in co-parenting with the government.
In Congress, Rich will never bend the knee to the Democrats and the radical teachers’ unions that control them. He will defend parental rights and always put the best interests of students first. And for Rich, that means teaching reading, writing, and arithmetic, not radical race theories.
- Ban federal funding for school districts that teach CRT or promote remote learning
- End Mask Mandates in Schools
- Encourage School Choice and Parental Options
- Support Rights THAT EMPOWER PARENTS AGAINST A CORRUPT SCHOOL SYSTEM

pages.title: Opportunity Restored | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Opportunity Restored
Raised by a single mother, Dr. Rich McCormick got his first job in middle school as a paperboy and by the age of 15 became a bus boy and cook. Rich worked his way through college and was commissioned an officer in the Marine Corps. He then obtained an MBA while attending night school and through hard work, was able to continue his pursuit of the American Dream. Eventually he went to medical school and is now an Emergency Medicine Physician.
Rich recognizes the opportunities that allowed us to prosper are under attack by the Biden Administration. Inflation is soaring beyond wage increases. Biden proposed the largest tax increase in history and imposed draconian regulations on local businesses.
Rich will stop this slide towards socialism and create legislation to:
- Provide real tax relief for middle class families
- Remove unnecessary regulation that limit growth with no benefit
- Promote entrepreneurship and innovation to grow the economy
- Get the Supply Chain Moving and Restock Our Shelves

pages.title: Safety Secured | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Safety
Dr. Rich McCormick believes two things can and must be true: law and order is and must be the bedrock of our Republic; all men are created equally and should be treated as such under the law.
Safety for our businesses and homes is a top priority for Rich McCormick. He vigorously opposes defunding the police as it would lead to a dramatic increase in violent crime.
Dr. McCormick will also work to make certain that federal, state, and local law enforcement have the resources and training required to combat the flow of illegal drugs, stop criminal gangs, and end human trafficking.
He will fight to end Biden’s open-door policies to illegal immigrants and deport those who have been shipped to our communities.
- Fully Fund and Support Law Enforcement
- Build the Wall and Rid Our Communities of Illegal Immigrants
- Hold Violent Criminals and Drug Pushers Accountable for their Crimes

pages.title: Elections Protected | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Elections Protected
Joe Biden and his cronies in Congress are seeking to rig our elections for generations. They want to strip away local control of elections and put Washington bureaucrats in control. They even wan force you to pay for congressional campaigns! Even worse, they want to stop widely supported voter ID laws that ensure only legal votes count.
That is not the America Rich McCormick fought for as a Marine and Naval Commander. Rich believes in election integrity and making certain that every American can vote and it is impossible to cheat.
In Congress, Rich will fight against ALL attempts to federalize our elections, force taxpayers to pay for the elections of the entitled elitist class and improve election integrity.
- Secure Free and Fair Elections
- Stop Federalization of Elections
- Require an ID to Vote
- No Tax Dollars for Entitled Politicians

pages.title: 2nd Amendment Defended | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## 2nd Amendment Defended
As a decorated Marine and Naval Commander, Rich swore an oath to defend our constitution. He knows that the right of a legal citizen owning a firearm is one of the rights under greatest assault by the radical left.
Rich will never waver in his defense of the 2 nd Amendment and will oppose any and all attempts to infringe upon them.
Rich will also seek to expand the rights of law-abiding citizens by expanding concealed carry reciprocity nationwide.
- Defend the 2 nd Amendment
- Stop Biden’s Gun Grab Attempts
- Ensure Concealed Carry is Respected Nationally

pages.title: Sanity in Healthcare Restored | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
## Sanity in Healthcare Restored
Dr. Rich McCormick is in his third year of serving on the frontlines in the emergency room to combat COVID. Through it all, he has followed the ACTUAL science, not the pandemic fears, and called out ridiculous mask and vaccine mandates – making him the enemy of the left.
And as a practicing physician, Rich knows that our healthcare system is the best in the world and that the last thing we can afford is the Joe Biden-Bernie Sanders single-payer healthcare scheme. Not only will it ADD $32 trillion to our tax burden over the next ten years, but it will also destroy 160 million private health insurance plans and reduce access to quality healthcare.
To fix healthcare and make it more affordable and sane again, it’s time to send a physician to DC. In Congress, Rich will champion patient-centered healthcare solutions to:
- End Restrictions on those who have immunity (Vaccines are a choice)
- Create Pricing transparency to force prices down through competition
- Allow hospital visitations without unfair restrictions
- 100% pro-life doctor
- End Mask Mandates – Everywhere!
- Stop Biden’s Socialized Medicine Schemes that Would Eliminate 160 Million Insurance Plans
- Slash Federally-mandated Paperwork that Robs Doctors of Time with Patients
- Allow Patients to Choose What is Best for Them and Their Family

pages.title: Dr. Rich McCormick: “The radical left’s woke agenda is doing irreparable harm to the U.S. military” | Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
September 27, 2022
## Dr. Rich McCormick: “The radical left’s woke agenda is doing irreparable harm to the U.S. military”
In response to a recently exposed “Diversity and Inclusion” training within the U.S. Air Force, where cadets are urged to use gender neutral language and avoid terms like “Mom” and “Dad”, Marine pilot and Emergency Room Physician, Dr. Rich McCormick, issued the following statement:
“The Administration’s failed foreign policy led to the deaths of 13 service members and undermined our Nation’s strength and credibility on the global stage. Overseas a war rages on in Ukraine as China continues to provoke their neighbors and the West,” said Dr. McCormick. “At home, our border is broken, and fentanyl is flooding into our country. Lawlessness abounds in major cities from coast to coast and Americans are fearing for their lives.
“But the latest – and most pressing – threat to our national security, freedom, and future is the radical left’s woke agenda, which is doing irreparable harm to the U.S. military. From forcing CRT and diversity training in the classroom to adding rainbow flag stickers to helmets during Gay Pride Month, military leaders are more concerned with political correctness than equipping our soldiers with the tools and knowledge to ‘locate, close with and destroy the enemy by fire and maneuver.’
“This is not the time for our men and women in uniform to be indoctrinated and radicalized. With so much at stake, including the safety and security of the American people, the politicization of the military must end full stop.”

pages.text:
## America Revived
Dr. McCormick served our country in the military for over 20 years, and doesn’t want to see it become the next Venezuela or Cuba. That is why he is 100% ALL IN to stop AOC and her socialist Squad from bringing those same radical policies to America.
Rich knows that America is at it’s best when we get government out of the way of job creators and empower them to build their businesses with less regulatory burdens. He will do everything possible to defend the American Dream for all people by assuring upward mobility and better income that accompanies a strong economy.
He will continue to find innovative ways to:
- Encourage business growth and job creation
- Stop Socialized Healthcare
- Limit Government and Protect Individual Liberty
- Preserve the American Dream for Future Generations

pages.title: Dr. Rich McCormick for Congress
pages.text:
Freedom. Affordability. Prosperity.
"I left the ER to fight for the same families I treated. Georgia deserves leaders who show up."
Dr. Rich McCormick
## Join
By checking the box and providing your phone number, you agree to receive SMS messages from Friends of McCormick. Donations may be solicited. Message frequency may vary. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out. Reply HELP for help. We will not share mobile information with third parties for promotional or marketing purposes. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our SMS program details and dedicated opt-in form, SMS Privacy Policy, and SMS Terms and Conditions.
## Service before self.
Dr. Rich McCormick has spent his life running toward the fights that matter.
Raised by a single mother, he worked his way through school, became a Marine
helicopter pilot, served in combat zones, earned his medical degree at Morehouse
School of Medicine, and cared for Georgia families as an emergency room physician.
In Congress, Rich brings the same mindset to lowering costs, securing communities,
strengthening America, and making Washington work for the people it serves.
As an ER doctor, Rich learned that good intentions are not enough — the patient
has to get better. As a Marine pilot, he learned that accountability is not optional
when lives are on the line. In Congress, he brings that same standard to Washington:
practical solutions, compassion for the people affected, and measurable results.
Freedom. Affordability. Prosperity.
## Hard decisions under pressure.
Rich has made them in helicopters, in the ER, in Afghanistan, and in Congress.
## Emergency Room Doctor
Rich knows healthcare from the front line, not a talking point. He is working
to make care more affordable, protect patients, and put doctors and families
ahead of bureaucracy.
## Decorated Marine Pilot
As a Marine and Navy Commander, Rich served in Africa, the Persian Gulf, and
Afghanistan. He understands that peace comes through strength.
## Independent Results
Rich supports you. He fights waste, red tape, and special interests so families
can keep more of what they earn.
## A lifetime of service.
Raised by a single mother
Worked his way through school
Joined the Marines
Student body president, Morehouse School of Medicine
Emergency room physician
United States Congressman
## Rich supports you.
Safer neighborhoods, lower costs, better healthcare, stronger families, and a
country that leads with confidence.
## Parents, Standards, and Students First
- Parents deserve the truth about whether their children are learning — not excuses, jargon, or lowered standards.
- Rich is fighting for schools that teach the basics, respect parents, support local control, and prepare students for real opportunity.
- He has backed opportunity pipelines for disadvantaged students, future physicians, scientists, and public servants, and introduced the HBCU Empowerment and Reform Act to modernize outdated federal education definitions.
Put parents first, restore high standards, support local control, and make sure
every student has a fair shot.
## A Future Georgians Can Afford
- Georgia families know the economy by the grocery receipt, the electric bill, the rent payment, and the cost of filling up the car.
- Rich is fighting inflationary spending, deficits, and debt that make everyday life more expensive for working families.
- He introduced the Incentivize Savings Act to give federal agencies a reason to save taxpayer money — because Washington should be held to the same discipline families practice every month.
Cut inflationary spending, lower taxes, unleash American energy, and reduce the
## Care That's Human and Affordable
- As an ER doctor, Rich has seen what happens when patients have insurance but still cannot afford care.
- He is fighting for a healthcare system that connects patients to doctors, lowers costs, increases transparency, and cuts the bureaucracy standing between families and treatment.
- Rich introduced the Medical Professional Access Act to expand access to qualified professionals during natural disasters, and he has led TRICARE and VA community-care reimbursement bills focused on real access to care.
Put patients and doctors back at the center of healthcare — with more access,
more transparency, and lower costs.
## Peace Through Strength
- As a Marine pilot and Navy Commander, Rich knows readiness is not a slogan. It is preparation, discipline, and responsibility before the crisis comes.
- Rich supports America's servicemembers, our strongest allies, and responsible investments in the capabilities needed to defend American interests abroad.
- He introduced the ROTOR Act with bipartisan Armed Services support to strengthen military readiness.
Support servicemembers, invest responsibly in readiness, and keep America strong
enough to deter conflict.
## Make Washington Work for People
- Government should make it easier to build, work, travel, and serve a community.
- Rich is fighting costly federal red tape when it delays roads, raises costs, closes local recreation, or hurts small businesses and families.
- From fighting to keep Lake Lanier campgrounds open, to challenging agencies that fail the people they serve, Rich believes Washington should answer to communities.
Cut costly regulations, back small businesses, and make Washington serve
## Results Over Performance
- Rich believes public service should be measured by results, not speeches, slogans, or press releases.
- He has helped bring over $319 million back to the district and its people since taking office.
- He introduced the Litigation Reimbursement Act to push accountability in the legal system and continues working across Armed Services, Oversight, and Science policy to deliver practical results for Georgia.
Solve problems, measure results, hold government accountable, and put Georgia
families ahead of Washington politics.
## Secure Communities. Secure Country.
- A country that cannot enforce its laws cannot keep faith with its citizens.
- Rich supports real border security, accountability after repeated federal failures, and policies that protect communities and restore control at the southern border.
- He introduced and passed the Economic Espionage Prevention Act and introduced the Humanitarian Theft Enforcement Act to confront foreign abuse, corruption, and threats to American interests.
Secure the border, support law enforcement, and restore
accountability at home and abroad.
## Trust in Every Legal Vote
- Self-government depends on trust. Every voter should know the rules are clear, the process is transparent, and every legal vote is protected.
- Rich supports election integrity measures that strengthen confidence, demand accountability, and make sure officials and agencies provide clear answers.
- Election security is not about helping one party. It is about protecting the constitutional system every American depends on.
Protect election integrity with clear rules, transparency, and confidence in every
Not a Career Politician
## He has served in uniform, in scrubs, and now in Congress.
Rich did not learn leadership from Washington. He learned it in combat zones,
treating patients fighting for life, and serving alongside the men and women who
put their country first.
## Uniform
Serving as a U.S. Marine and Navy Commander in Africa, the Persian Gulf,
Afghanistan, and most places in between.
## Scrubs
Treating Georgia families in the emergency room, where every decision matters.
## Congress
Bringing that same discipline and service to fight for Georgia's 7th District.
## Rep. Rich McCormick qualifies for reelection for District 7
The Forsyth County News reports that Congressman Rich McCormick has qualified
for reelection in Georgia's 7th Congressional District, which includes all of
Forsyth, Dawson, and Lumpkin counties, along with portions of east Cherokee,
north Fulton, and west Hall counties.
Help reach voters, support local events, and keep Georgia's 7th District moving forward.
## Media and campaign contact
For interviews, media credentials, and campaign assets, reach the press team directly.
Logos, photos, and contact details are in the press kit.
